environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (no WAF). LDAP service account has read access to full directory tree. Service account credentials stored in environment variables, rotated manually during quarterly maintenance windows. Network allows direct LDAP traffic from container to directory server on port 389.

config.network: VPC with LDAP server accessible on port 389, no TLS enforcement
config.load_balancer: ALB with default HTTP listener, no WAF association
config.secrets_management: Environment variables set at task definition, manual rotation
config.ldap_service_account_permissions: cn=svc-auth has subtree read on dc=corp,dc=internal
